body-strong.purpose: Settings group titles and the list heading.

body.purpose: Card and job titles, buttons, inputs; the window's base font.

caption.purpose: Window title, descriptions, job meta, field errors, footer, small buttons.

icons.family: Segoe Fluent Icons, Segoe MDL2 Assets
icons.note: Font-based, provided by Windows; not bundled.

shadows.name: focus-inner-ring
shadows.purpose: Inner contrast ring of the Fluent double-stroke focus visual, paired with outline: 2px solid var(--focus-outer) at 1px offset. The only box-shadow in the system.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Hover and press fills on buttons, caption buttons, toggle track, job rows.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Fluent decelerate curve for entrances, knob travel, progress width.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Page swap between Downloads and Settings.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse under prefers-reduced-motion; the indeterminate bar stops.

themes.dark: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) overrides; mirrored by -dark keys in the frontmatter.
themes.mica: html.mica sets the body transparent so the native Mica backdrop shows; otherwise solid-ground.

knownGaps: The custom maximize button does not show the Snap Layouts flyout; that needs a native hit-test layer.
The ComboBox dropdown and `title=` tooltips are browser-drawn, not Fluent flyouts or tooltips.
Icons rely on the Segoe Fluent Icons font installed with Windows 11 (Segoe MDL2 Assets fallback on Windows 10); nothing is bundled.
Visual checks render at `preview/*.html` with a mocked Tauri API, regenerated by `preview/build.py`.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 68px; width: 400px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-1, rgba(0,0,0,0.896)); background: var(--card, rgba(255,255,255,0.7)); border: 1px solid var(--card-stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.0578)); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-card-icon { flex: none; } .ds-card-text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--text-2, rgba(0,0,0,0.606)); } .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); background: var(--track, rgba(0,0,0,0.0578)); transition: background-color 0.083s linear; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 3px; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: -6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-2, rgba(0,0,0,0.606)); transition: left 0.167s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1), width 0.167s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1), height 0.167s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1), margin 0.167s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1); } .ds-toggle:hover .ds-knob { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: -7px; left: 2px; } .ds-toggle:active .ds-knob { width: 17px; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-track { background: var(--accent, #005fb8); border-color: transparent; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-track .ds-knob { left: 23px; background: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-toggle:hover input:checked + .ds-track { background: var(--accent-hover, rgba(0,95,184,0.9)); } .ds-toggle:hover input:checked + .ds-track .ds-knob { left: 22px; } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + .ds-track { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-outer, rgba(0,0,0,0.896)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-job { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; width: 400px; padding: 10px 8px 10px 12px; font: 14px/20px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-1, rgba(0,0,0,0.896)); background: var(--card, rgba(255,255,255,0.7)); border: 1px solid var(--card-stroke, rgba(0,0,0,0.0578)); border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 0.083s linear; } .ds-job:hover { background: var(--card-hover, rgba(249,249,249,0.5)); } .ds-tile { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--subtle-hover, rgba(0,0,0,0.0373)); color: var(--accent, #005fb8); } .ds-job-body { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-job-title { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-job-meta { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--text-2, rgba(0,0,0,0.606)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-progress { position: relative; height: 3px; margin-top: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-progress::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--control-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); } .ds-progress-bar { position: relative; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--accent, #005fb8); transition: width 0.25s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1); }

narrative.overview:
ClipDrop is drawn as if Microsoft shipped it in PowerToys. There is no metaphor and no themed world: the Windows 11 Fluent category standard is played straight, and the craft lives in getting the conventions exactly right (WinUI 3 resource values, the Fluent type ramp, double-stroke focus, settings-card anatomy, 46×40 caption buttons). The window is a receipt, glanced at for a few seconds while the app works from the tray, so it is dense, quiet, and immediately legible.

Depth comes from the material stack rather than shadow: a Mica backdrop (applied natively; the body goes transparent under `html.mica`, otherwise a solid neutral ground), translucent layer cards over it, and hairline 1px strokes. The theme follows the system light/dark setting through `prefers-color-scheme`; every token has a light and dark value. Color is almost entirely neutral; the Windows default accent blue appears only on the primary action, checked toggles, progress, focus underline, and selection.

The system rejects the generic web-app look: no web header, no centered hero input, no footer drawer, no decorative shadows, no brand-color washes.
keyCharacteristics: Native Windows 11 Fluent anatomy: custom 40px title bar, caption buttons at the right, settings cards, InfoBar, ToggleSwitch, ProgressBar, ComboBox.
WinUI 3 light/dark resource values, switched by the system theme.
Mica or solid ground, translucent cards, 1px hairlines; no drop shadows.
Segoe UI Variable on the Fluent ramp (Caption 12, Body 14, Subtitle 20, Title 28).
Segoe Fluent Icons as the only icon set.
Fluent motion: 83ms linear state fades, decelerating `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)` entrances, all collapsed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The System Accent Rule
rules.body: The only chromatic UI color is the Windows default accent. The violet of the placeholder app icon is not a UI color and never appears outside the icon.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color is defined twice, light and dark, from the WinUI 3 resources; a value without its dark twin is not a token.

rules.name: The Fluent Ramp Rule
rules.body: Sizes come only from the Fluent ramp (12, 14, 20, 28). No in-between sizes, no letter-spacing, no uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Material Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from fill alpha and hairline strokes. If an element needs to stand apart, change its layer, not its shadow.

rules.name: The Double Stroke Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is a 2px outer stroke (text-primary contrast) offset 1px with a 1px inner contrast ring; inside the title bar the outline is inset (-2px). Focus is never shown on pointer click.

dos: **Do** take every color from the WinUI 3 light/dark resources and define both themes.
**Do** build new settings as settings cards (glyph, title, description, control at the right) in groups with a Body Strong title.
**Do** use Segoe Fluent Icons code points for every glyph, with Segoe MDL2 Assets as fallback.
**Do** keep state transitions at 83ms linear and entrances on `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)`, and collapse all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep one accent button per view.
**Do** keep the body transparent under `html.mica` so the native backdrop shows through.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, glows, or gradients; depth is layer fill and hairline only.
**Don't** use colors outside the token set, including the app icon's violet.
**Don't** introduce sizes off the Fluent ramp, uppercase labels, or letter-spacing.
**Don't** add a web-style header, centered hero input, or footer drawer.
**Don't** use radii other than 4px (controls), 6px (layers) and the toggle pill.
